items.information:
# **This competition takes place on a weekday**

This competition is organized by the Cubing Club at UVU. Club members are eligible for a discounted registration fee. Membership is open to both UVU and non-UVU students. For more details, visit the [Cubing Club at UVU tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WolverineWeekdays1Orem2025#53555-cubing-club-at-uvu).

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
